capabilities.name: Find Owners
capabilities.description: Search for clinic customers and navigate matching owner records.

capabilities.name: Register Owner
capabilities.description: Create a new clinic customer record with contact information.

capabilities.name: Maintain Owner Details
capabilities.description: View and update an owner's profile and associated clinic activity.

capabilities.name: Register Pet
capabilities.description: Add a pet to an existing owner with name, birth date, and pet type.

capabilities.name: Maintain Pet Details
capabilities.description: View and update an existing pet's identifying and classification information.

capabilities.name: Record Pet Visit
capabilities.description: Record a dated clinical visit and description for an owner's pet.

capabilities.name: Review Pet Visit History
capabilities.description: View previously recorded visits in the context of the pet and owner.

capabilities.name: Browse Veterinarians
capabilities.description: List veterinarians available through the clinic.

capabilities.name: Review Veterinarian Specialties
capabilities.description: Show the specialties associated with each veterinarian.

capabilities.name: Access Clinic Home
capabilities.description: Present the clinic landing page and primary navigation into owner and veterinarian workflows.

approval_effect: Approval freezes capability meaning only; evaluator mappings remain separately sealed.
